summary: Tested all 3 bug fixes from iteration_2: Footer text, Home stats label, and BEAST variant image switching. Also found and fixed a critical syntax error in Product.jsx (missing useMemo declaration) introduced during the fixes. After the fix, all variant swatches update gallery correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Product.jsx had a missing `const currentVariant = useMemo(() => {` declaration line (line 82). The useMemo body was orphaned, causing SyntaxError and crashing the product page. This was introduced when implementing the handleOptionChange fix. FIXED in this iteration.
passed_tests: Product page loads without syntax error (after fix)
BEAST page: Cyan Matte Metallic swatch updates gallery to cyan-specific images
BEAST page: Lens Type auto-updates to CarbonGlo™ Oil Slick Mirror when Cyan frame selected
BEAST page: 4 thumbnails shown for each variant
BEAST page: Orange Matte Metallic swatch shows orange-specific images
BEAST page: Redcat Red Matte Metallic swatch shows red-specific images
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-2 bugs are fixed. Product.jsx syntax error was also fixed (missing useMemo declaration). All BEAST variant swatches (Black, Pink, Orange, Red, Cyan) now correctly update gallery images. Homepage footer and stats labels are correct.

rca_of_issue.root_cause: When E1 implemented the handleOptionChange smart fallback, the `const currentVariant = useMemo(() => {` line was accidentally deleted, leaving an orphaned useMemo body after the handleOptionChange closing brace. This caused a Babel SyntaxError at line 86.
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Added the missing `const currentVariant = useMemo(() => {` declaration before the orphaned useMemo body at line 82 of Product.jsx.
